method: Independent fresh-context agent executions; exact user prompts, skill location and read-only boundaries supplied; expected assertions withheld. Parent manually graded saved user-facing responses and read traces.
model: Inherited session model; no model override requested
limits: One final passing sample per scenario, not a statistical reliability estimate. Access/services retain their initial passing runs; changed stair/energy routes were retested. Parent grader is not independent of skill author.

assertions.assertion: Identifies APP-176 paragraphs 3–4 and existing B(P)R regulations/schedules versus presently advisory additions
assertions.evidence: APP-176 paragraphs 3–4 separates regulations 72–73 / Third-Fourth Schedules from advisory additions.

assertions.assertion: Checks applicability and approved arrangements before dimensions
assertions.evidence: Requests measured plan, approved records, alteration scope and user needs before project-specific dimensions.

assertions.assertion: Does not import an ADA plan as local compliance or give an automatic existing-building exemption
assertions.evidence: Requires redrawing the ADA reference; says existing constraints do not automatically grant exemption.

assertions.assertion: Rejects winders for the B14.2 required-stair case
Identifies the 5a exception of at least 280 mm tread and at most 150 mm riser rather than general 225/175 values
assertions.evidence: Gives 280 mm minimum tread and 150 mm maximum riser for 5a.

assertions.assertion: Checks remaining landing, width, headroom and accessibility requirements and does not certify approval
assertions.evidence: Checks landings, headroom and width and explicitly states Accessibility remains unresolved with AP review; refuses approval.

assertions.assertion: Applies the 5a-specific B23 flight/turn checks rather than treating the general B14 flight rule as sufficient
assertions.evidence: Applies B23 flight/turn requirements including successive flights and the over-12-step turn condition.

assertions.assertion: Does not use contract date as the completion-and-connection deadline for the 2020 grace provision
assertions.evidence: Uses both completion and connection by 31 December 2026; rejects signing date.

assertions.assertion: Rechecks current electrical edition and requires REC/REW inspection/testing and WR1 before use
assertions.evidence: Checks EMSD live transition and installation guidance; specifies 2025 basis and REC/REW testing plus WR1.

assertions.assertion: Separates WSD water-supply requirements from BD drainage alteration and minor-works classification
assertions.evidence: Separates WSD supply scope from BD drainage items and requires actual item-condition review.

assertions.assertion: Uses the appropriate residential/non-residential BEAM Plus Interiors manual with actual evidence rather than point conversion
assertions.evidence: Selects BI v2.0 Residential Units for the flat, checks eligibility/circulars/credit evidence; rejects conversion.

assertions.assertion: Explains the IAQ scheme eligibility and rejects automatic certification for a split-only home
assertions.evidence: Explains eligible offices/public places and MVAC, excluding split-only flat while noting qualifying mixed systems.

assertions.assertion: Distinguishes area-related retrofits from other applicable routes including central services and phased works
assertions.evidence: Identifies central-services route and aggregation over 12 months; directs REA scope review.

assertions.assertion: Separates voluntary certification from statutory duties
assertions.evidence: Explicitly separates statutory energy duties, voluntary certification and client targets.
